# Choose your CALIBER path

This page exists so a reader can choose the right documentation path first,
before dropping into deep reference or architecture pages.

## At a glance

| Reader | Start here | Then go to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Developer / integrator | [SDK guide](m-20-sdk-guide.md) | [Auth and project scoping](m-31-auth-and-project-scoping.md), [SDK vs REST API](m-36-sdk-vs-rest-api.md), [Developer troubleshooting](m-55-developer-troubleshooting.md) |
| Operator / admin | [Local bring-up guide](m-32-local-bring-up.md) | [Configuration and provider setup](m-48-configuration-and-provider-setup.md), [Health and readiness](m-50-health-and-readiness.md), [Operations runbook](m-19-runbook.md) |
| System user | [Workflows](m-42-use-workflows.md) | [Prompts](m-38-use-prompts.md), [Knowledge bases](m-43-use-knowledge-bases.md), [Aria assistant](m-46-use-aria-assistant.md) |
| Evaluator / governance user | [Trust and governance guide](m-33-trust-and-governance.md) | [Evaluation](m-14-evaluation.md), [Calibration](m-15-calibration.md), [QA plan](m-13-qa-plan.md) |
| Architect | [Architecture reader guide](m-34-architecture-reader-guide.md) | [Layered architecture](m-00-layered-architecture.md), [Platform](m-01-platform.md), [Refinement loop](m-00-refinement-loop.md) |
| Decision-maker | [Decision-maker overview](m-35-decision-maker-overview.md) | [Competitive analysis](m-17-competitive-analysis.md), [Roadmap](m-18-roadmap.md) |

## 1. If you are integrating with CALIBER

Start with the Python SDK unless you have a concrete reason to work at the raw
HTTP layer.

Use the REST API directly when:

- you are not integrating from Python
- you need to compare wire behavior against the SDK
- you are working with an endpoint before a typed SDK method exists

Recommended path:

1. [SDK guide](m-20-sdk-guide.md)
2. [Auth and project scoping](m-31-auth-and-project-scoping.md)
3. [SDK vs REST API](m-36-sdk-vs-rest-api.md)
4. [Error handling and retries](m-53-error-handling-and-retries.md)
5. [SDK API reference](m-21-sdk-reference.md)

## 2. If you are operating a deployment

Start from bring-up and readiness, not from architecture.

Recommended path:

1. [Local bring-up guide](m-32-local-bring-up.md)
2. [Configuration and provider setup](m-48-configuration-and-provider-setup.md)
3. [Health and readiness](m-50-health-and-readiness.md)
4. [Operator troubleshooting](m-51-operator-troubleshooting.md)
5. [Operations runbook](m-19-runbook.md)

## 3. If you are evaluating trust, governance, or release posture

Start from the trust surfaces that connect evidence, review, and apply.

Recommended path:

1. [Trust and governance guide](m-33-trust-and-governance.md)
2. [Evaluation and test sets](m-44-use-evaluation-and-test-sets.md)
3. [Calibration](m-45-use-calibration.md)
4. [Review and release flows](m-47-use-review-and-release-flows.md)

## 4. If you need system architecture

Start from the layered model, then read only the deep subsystem pages that
matter for the question you are answering.

Recommended path:

1. [Architecture reader guide](m-34-architecture-reader-guide.md)
2. [Layered architecture](m-00-layered-architecture.md)
3. [Platform](m-01-platform.md)
4. the subsystem pages that matter for your topic

## 5. If you are deciding whether CALIBER fits

Start from the platform shape and the market position, not the route modules.

Recommended path:

1. [Decision-maker overview](m-35-decision-maker-overview.md)
2. [Competitive analysis](m-17-competitive-analysis.md)
3. [Roadmap](m-18-roadmap.md)
